content: I am working on Member 4's Coverage, Calendar & Scheduling-Rules area. Help me break the requirements into working-day calculation, country-specific weekends, public holidays, team coverage, minimum staffing, blackout periods and AI-2 coverage analysis.

The M4 responsibilities should be separated into reusable services. The working-day and holiday-aware calculation should be a single source of truth and should read the country weekend configuration. Coverage should calculate staffing impact in application code, while AI-2 should explain the impact and suggest alternatives. Blackout periods and minimum staffing should remain deterministic business rules.
What edge cases should I consider before coding?

Important cases include public holidays inside a leave range, different weekend configurations by country, ranges containing no working days, overlapping approved leave, minimum staffing thresholds, overlapping blackout periods, and the distinction between BLOCK and SPECIAL_APPROVAL blackout modes.

The repository design later reflects these responsibilities in calculationService.js, weekendConfigService.js, coverage.js and staffingService.js. The M4 design also explicitly treats the calculation service as the shared source of truth.
